lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Brunhilde Zhong is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Brunhilde is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.
d41: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead — and presses the tribute down to 3,000 kcal/week while the chair is empty. They'll test the link. Count on it. (Trust -8.)

d41: 🕯️ Brunhilde's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Emberhold. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
d41: 🕯️ Brunhilde Zhong is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Brunhilde kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Brunhilde's gone." Jovan looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Brunhilde." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Kavya blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Tireless Stride (Level 1). You walk like water downhill — no wasted steps, no wasted breath. Every mile costs 15% less.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Brunhilde Zhong, 41 days. The mantle passes to Kavya Porter.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Kavya Porter, 26 — a postal worker. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room, Bird Whisperer, Fusion Reactor.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Brunhilde — and Brunhilde is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Cesar, Violet, Karina and 2 more speak for Kavya — "Brunhilde trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Kavya before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: ★ IDENTIFIED: Guava. Fragrant, soft, pink inside. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
d111: SYSTEM: Oh! It has a NAME. You all love names.
d111: Jovan was watching. Now they know Guava too.
d111: 🏆 The Company did that. Not one hero — the whole shape of them, moving together. The village will hear this one with the name attached.
d111: 📺 The Company — You brought down Ugly-Eyes. (The village watches the broadcast. Nobody blinks.)
